people.name: Aimee Bock
people.description: Founder of Feeding Our Future nonprofit. Convicted on federal fraud charges for orchestrating the largest pandemic fraud scheme in US history. Ordered to forfeit $5.2 million.

people.name: Abdiaziz Farah
people.description: Operated multiple fraudulent meal sites through Empire Cuisine. Convicted and sentenced to federal prison.

people.name: Mohamed Jama Ismail
people.description: Operated fraudulent meal distribution sites. Convicted of federal fraud charges.

people.name: Qamar Ahmed Hassan
people.description: Convicted for role in Feeding Our Future fraud scheme.

people.name: Tikki Brown
people.description: Commissioner of Minnesota Department of Children, Youth and Families. Confirmed none of the daycares in viral video had payments paused. Overseeing state response to fraud allegations.
people.note: Government official - track statements and oversight actions
